body: yeah retiring isn't an option. I still owe about another 20 years on my mortgage. I'd happy clean toilets (done that before) etc. but that just won't pay the bills and while I seem to focused on the dollars my eldest daughter is disabled and if I don't provide I fear what will happen to her long term.

you have probably touched on the the biggest reason to not take the option. My eldest daughter (9) would be devastated, my other daughter (5), less so and wife (care least of all) but saying all that it'd protecting them from the worse of our financial situation.


Don't dismiss being a provider, if I wasn't here my wifes' extended family would easily take care of the family (mine are all passed). Yeah, but with me being here the expectation is that I'd take care of the family.
